task_fulfillment.rationale: The requested SOP and reusable form, plus a companion tracker, are substantially delivered. Material corrections remain: unsupported Finance governance and escalation authority, incomplete escalation authentication, and inconsistent compliance routing. The undefined retention-policy reference also assumes an available policy without confirmation. A blank reusable form is reasonable because the source asks for a template and supplies no actual change. Missing organizational locations and identifiers may legitimately remain finalization items; visual rendering and human acceptance were not assessed.
